hunks.baseline: The wrinkled skin around the old man’s eyes twitched. He tossed and turned with a groan, then finally opened his eyes after a long while.
hunks.sol: The wrinkles around the old man’s eyes twitched. He stirred with a groan and, after a long while, finally managed to open his eyes.

hunks.baseline: *Where is this…?*
hunks.sol: *Where am I…?*

hunks.baseline: Instead of damp, yellowing wallpaper, he saw a ceiling so starkly white that it was almost oppressive.
hunks.sol: Instead of damp, yellow-stained wallpaper, he saw a ceiling so starkly white that it was almost oppressive.

hunks.baseline: The old man lay there blankly, unable to make sense of the situation, until a calm voice reached his ears.
hunks.sol: He lay there blankly, unable to make sense of the situation, until a calm voice reached his ears.

hunks.baseline: Finding the owner of the voice was not difficult.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t hard to find the source of the voice.

hunks.baseline: The old man sat up with a start and saw a young man sitting before a small brazier and looking at him.
hunks.sol: The old man sat up with a start and saw a young man seated before a small brazier, watching him.

hunks.baseline: Only then did the old man realize that this unfamiliar place was a clinic. He also realized the identity of the young man, who looked barely more than a boy.
hunks.sol: Only then did the old man realize that this unfamiliar place was a clinic—and who the young man, who looked barely more than a boy, must be.

hunks.baseline: The old man had been speaking with a bewildered expression when a sudden headache rose through him, and he let out a groan.
hunks.sol: As he spoke in bewilderment, a sudden headache made him groan.

hunks.baseline: Only now did he realize that his already-aged body ached everywhere, and that he was trembling, drenched in sweat.
hunks.sol: Only now did he realize that his aged body ached everywhere. He was drenched in sweat and trembling uncontrollably.

hunks.baseline: The young medical apprentice had already crossed the room and came to his rescue.
hunks.sol: The young medical apprentice crossed the room and came to his aid.

hunks.baseline: “I’m going to place a few needles now. Relax and breathe slowly. All right. One. Two…”
hunks.sol: “I’m going to insert a few needles now. Calm yourself and breathe slowly. All right. One. Two…”

hunks.baseline: The old man’s eyes went round. The crown of his head prickled as though an ant had bitten him, and then his headache vanished as if it had been washed away.
hunks.sol: The old man’s eyes widened. The crown of his head prickled as though an ant had bitten him, and then his headache vanished without a trace.

hunks.baseline: The young medical apprentice smiled faintly as he held a slender needle and watched the old man stare at him in surprise.
hunks.sol: Holding a slender needle, the young medical apprentice smiled faintly at the old man’s astonished stare.

hunks.baseline: “Then lie back down. From what I’ve observed over the past two days, there doesn’t seem to be anything seriously wrong, fortunately… but you still shouldn’t be moving around yet.”
hunks.sol: “Then lie back down. From what I’ve observed over the past two days, fortunately, there doesn’t seem to be anything seriously wrong… but you still shouldn’t be moving around yet.”

hunks.baseline: His medical skills were nothing short of miraculous. On top of that, there was something about his presence that made both body and mind feel inexplicably at ease.
hunks.sol: His medical skills were nothing short of miraculous, and something about his presence inexplicably put both body and mind at ease.

hunks.baseline: Up close, he looked much younger than expected, yet he seemed more seasoned than even an elderly medical apprentice.
hunks.sol: Up close, he looked even younger than the old man had thought, yet somehow seemed more seasoned than a physician many times his age.

hunks.baseline: “I’ll help you. Relax your body and lie down slowly.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll help you. Relax and lie down slowly.”

hunks.baseline: As the old man lay back down as though entranced, the young medical apprentice raised several fingers.
hunks.sol: The old man lay back down as though entranced. The young medical apprentice raised several fingers.

hunks.baseline: “Correct. Where do you live, and what is your name and age?”
hunks.sol: “Correct. Where do you live, and what are your name and age?”

hunks.baseline: Unlike before, this required him to use his head a little.
hunks.sol: Unlike the earlier questions, these required some thought.

hunks.baseline: The old man had only just awakened, and his condition was still unstable. Feeling a faint headache, he slowly opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: The old man had only just awakened, and his condition was still unstable. Feeling the faint stirrings of another headache, he slowly answered.

hunks.baseline: “I’ve lived my whole life near Wuhan and Dongting Lake. My name is Gwak Bongchul. No one kept proper track when I was growing up, so I don’t know my exact age, but I reckon I must be past seventy.”
hunks.sol: “I’ve lived my whole life around Wuhan and Dongting Lake. My name is Gwak Bongchul. No one kept proper track when I was growing up, so I don’t know my exact age, but I reckon I must be past seventy.”

hunks.baseline: The old man frowned and hesitated, but then he remembered his occupation.
hunks.sol: The old man frowned and hesitated until his occupation came back to him.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. When I was young, I worked as a deckhand on a merchant ship. After buying my own boat, I mostly carried passengers around Dongting Lake and showed them the sights.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. When I was young, I worked as a deckhand on a merchant ship. After I bought my own boat, I mostly carried passengers around Dongting Lake and showed them the sights.”

hunks.baseline: Before long, the old man—no, the elderly boatman—began dredging up old memories and talking on his own. Each time he did, the young medical apprentice responded with a gentle smile and a nod.
hunks.sol: Before long, the old man—no, the elderly boatman—was delving into old memories and talking without prompting. Each time, the young medical apprentice encouraged him with a gentle smile and a nod.

hunks.baseline: “I had a close hyung I worked with. He told me that, ever since olden times, a man who bought a boat would soon find himself a woman. So I took the plunge and bought myself a sleek one. It was a boat made in Baekchu.”
hunks.sol: “There was an older fellow I used to work with. He put it into my head that a man with his own boat was bound to find himself a woman. So I took the plunge and bought a sleek little beauty made by Baekchu.”

hunks.baseline: “I wonder if you know Baekchu, sir. These days, you can find those boats everywhere at the Wuhan ferry docks, but when I was young, a man who piloted a vessel made in Baekchu was considered a first-rate husband prospect. Or an Audi. You know, the one with four circles on the bow.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know if you’ve heard of Baekchu, sir. These days, boats like that are common at the Wuhan ferry docks, but when I was young, a man who sailed a Baekchu vessel was considered a first-rate husband prospect. That, or an Audi. You know, the one with four circles on the bow.”

hunks.baseline: “Anyway, that boat I bought back then was sleek and beautiful. It attracted plenty of women, too. Once, a widow from the neighboring village came to see me late at night and asked me to show her the Baekchu. Then she suddenly yanked her dress ties open…!”
hunks.sol: “Anyway, that boat I bought was sleek and beautiful. It attracted plenty of women, too. Once, a widow from the neighboring village came to me late at night and asked me to show her the Baekchu. Then, all of a sudden, she yanked her dress ties open…!”

hunks.baseline: The young medical apprentice listened with patience far beyond his years, and as the story continued, the dam blocking the boatman’s memories slowly began to crumble.
hunks.sol: The young medical apprentice listened with patience far beyond his years. As the story continued, the solid dam blocking the boatman’s memories slowly began to crumble.

hunks.baseline: Then, as the boatman cheerfully continued talking without even noticing his aching body, one particular memory suddenly came back to him.
hunks.sol: Then, while the boatman cheerfully rambled on, his aching body forgotten, one particular memory suddenly resurfaced.

hunks.baseline: A memory like a nightmare.
hunks.sol: A nightmarish memory.

hunks.baseline: Thunder and an enraged roar rang clearly in his ears.
hunks.sol: The crash of thunder and a furious roar rang vividly in his ears.

hunks.baseline: He slowly blinked, and the figure of a massive being standing against a black sky flashed before his eyes.
hunks.sol: He blinked slowly, and the image of a colossal being silhouetted against the black sky flashed before his eyes.

hunks.baseline: The boatman sprang upright without realizing it and stared blankly into the air.
hunks.sol: The boatman sprang upright and stared blankly into space.

hunks.baseline: His voice trembled, and his eyes were wide open.
hunks.sol: His voice trembled, and his eyes bulged.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps because he had exerted himself so suddenly, every part of his body began aching again. But the boatman paid no attention to any of it.
hunks.sol: The sudden movement made his entire body ache again, but he paid it no mind.

hunks.baseline: The memories that had surfaced as the dam in his mind collapsed were all he could think about.
hunks.sol: The memories flooding back through the broken dam consumed his thoughts.

hunks.baseline: “Me-medical apprentice! What did you say to me earlier?”
hunks.sol: “Me-medical apprentice! What did you say earlier?”

hunks.baseline: “Two days! Didn’t you say that two days had passed?”
hunks.sol: “Two days! Didn’t you say two days had passed?”

hunks.baseline: But the young medical apprentice did not so much as twitch an eyebrow as he calmly replied,
hunks.sol: The young medical apprentice didn’t so much as raise an eyebrow.

hunks.baseline: “T-this is no time to be calm. We must tell the people and report this to the higher-ups at once!”
hunks.sol: “T-this is no time to be calm. We have to warn everyone and report this to the higher-ups at once!”

hunks.baseline: His entire body was drenched in sweat and trembling without his realizing it, while his unfocused eyes darted anxiously in every direction.
hunks.sol: His entire body trembled, drenched in sweat without his even realizing it, while his unfocused eyes darted anxiously around the room.

hunks.baseline: “We have to get away as quickly as possible. Hurry!”
hunks.sol: “We have to run as quickly as possible. Hurry!”

hunks.baseline: That was when the young medical apprentice reached out toward the patient shouting as though he were having a fit.
hunks.sol: That was when the young medical apprentice reached toward the patient, who was shouting as though in the throes of a fit.

hunks.baseline: A perfectly white hand, without even a callus, touched the old man’s slightly hunched back. Warmth flowed from the hand and filled his body.
hunks.sol: A smooth white hand without a single callus touched the boatman’s slightly hunched back. Warmth flowed from it and filled his body.

hunks.baseline: The inexplicable phenomenon finally calmed the boatman, and he gasped for breath.
hunks.sol: The inexplicable phenomenon finally calmed him, and he gasped for breath.

hunks.baseline: “Think of it as a miscellaneous technique I’ve practiced from time to time. And, Elder.”
hunks.sol: “Think of it as a minor trick I picked up along the way. And, Elder.”

hunks.baseline: Why, he could not say, but the boatman met the medical apprentice’s deep, clear eyes and felt the words catch in his throat.
hunks.sol: The boatman met the medical apprentice’s deep, clear gaze, and for reasons he could not explain, the words caught in his throat.

hunks.baseline: The young medical apprentice gazed at him for a moment before slowly continuing.
hunks.sol: The young medical apprentice studied him for a moment before slowly continuing.

hunks.baseline: “The thing you’re worried about will never happen. Do you understand?”
hunks.sol: “What you fear will never come to pass. Do you understand?”

hunks.baseline: “It’s simple. Erase everything you saw, heard, and experienced from your mind. Two days ago, you were summoned to Dongting Lake with the government troops, but you collapsed because you were feeling unwell. You woke up today.”
hunks.sol: “It’s simple. Erase everything you saw, heard, and experienced from your mind. Two days ago, you were summoned to Dongting Lake with the government troops, but you collapsed because you were unwell. You woke up today.”

hunks.baseline: “Everything I’m telling you is true. It must become true. That day, you did not take any passengers, and you did not see the divine spirit of Dongting Lake.”
hunks.sol: “Everything I’m telling you is true. It must become true. That day, you carried no passengers, and you never saw the divine spirit of Dongting Lake.”

hunks.baseline: “D-does that mean you saw the divine spirit too, sir…?”
hunks.sol: “D-does that mean you saw the Divine Spirit too, sir…?”

hunks.baseline: “That may be the case, or it may not. But there is one thing you must remember… You must forget everything you remember about those events.”
hunks.sol: “That may be the case, or it may not. But there is one thing you must remember… You must forget everything that happened.”

hunks.baseline: The next moment, the suffocating silence in the room was broken by the last bit of courage possessed by a man over seventy.
hunks.sol: Then the suffocating silence in the room was broken by the last bit of courage a man over seventy could muster.

hunks.baseline: The young medical apprentice slowly shook his head and continued.
hunks.sol: The young medical apprentice slowly shook his head.

hunks.baseline: An official who governed a city under the Son of Heaven’s orders—a figure who, at least within Hubei Province, was no different from a king.
hunks.sol: An official who governed a city by order of the Son of Heaven—a man who, at least within Hubei Province, was as good as a king.

hunks.baseline: The boatman cried out reflexively at the unexpected appearance of such a high-ranking person. Then he realized his mistake, and his vision went dark.
hunks.sol: The boatman cried out reflexively at the mention of such a powerful figure. Then he realized his mistake, and his vision went dark.

hunks.baseline: *What a stupid fool! What if someone heard me?*
hunks.sol: *You stupid fool! What if someone heard you?*

hunks.baseline: Unlike him, however, the young medical apprentice’s expression remained relaxed.
hunks.sol: The young medical apprentice, however, remained perfectly at ease.

hunks.baseline: It was the composure of someone who had ensured that none of their conversation could leave the room.
hunks.sol: It was the composure of the person who had ensured that none of their conversation could leave the room.

hunks.baseline: No—even if their words did leak out, the young medical apprentice would not bat an eye.

hunks.baseline: He had taken these precautions solely to preserve the boatman’s life.
hunks.sol: The precaution was solely for the sake of the boatman’s life.

hunks.baseline: Unaware of that fact, the boatman spoke again in a tightly hushed voice.
hunks.sol: Unaware of that, the boatman spoke again in a tightly hushed voice.

hunks.baseline: “When floods come, droughts strike, and plagues spread, people die in every direction, and wars break out everywhere. Then the rebels who dream of becoming kings and high officials speak with one voice. They say that the will of Heaven has left the Son of Heaven. That we should overthrow this rotten country.”
hunks.sol: “When floods come, droughts strike, and plagues spread, people die everywhere and rebellions rise across the land. Then those traitors who dream of thrones and high office speak with one voice. They say the will of Heaven has abandoned the Son of Heaven. That this rotten country must be overthrown.”

hunks.baseline: The young medical apprentice clicked his tongue softly, stood up, and tossed out one final remark.
hunks.sol: The young medical apprentice clicked his tongue softly and rose.

hunks.baseline: “Even disasters beyond human power lead to this sort of thing. So what would happen if a divine spirit as enormous as a mountain went berserk in Dongting Lake?”
hunks.sol: “Even disasters beyond human power lead to such things. So what do you suppose would happen if the divine spirit of Dongting Lake, a creature as vast as a mountain, went mad and ran wild?”

hunks.baseline: “Thousands died. The Yangtze and Dongting Lake were filled with corpses and blood, and the streets that once shone like daylight were swallowed by darkness. With the frightened people watching Hubei Province, what do you think would happen if everyone learned what you saw and heard?”
hunks.sol: “Thousands died. The Yangtze and Dongting Lake were filled with corpses and blood, and streets that once blazed through the night fell dark. Now, with the frightened people watching Hubei Province, what do you think would happen if everyone learned what you saw and heard?”

hunks.baseline: He did not finish the sentence, but in the suffocating silence, the boatman arrived at the answer on his own.
hunks.sol: He left the rest unsaid, but in the suffocating silence, the boatman found the answer himself.

hunks.baseline: If anything, carrying countless passengers by boat had allowed him to learn how the world worked by listening to their conversations.
hunks.sol: If anything, ferrying countless passengers had taught him how the world worked through the conversations he overheard.

hunks.baseline: *If I so much as speak the facts I know aloud…*
hunks.sol: *If I so much as breathe a word about what I know…*

hunks.baseline: It would all be over.
hunks.sol: It would be the end of him.

hunks.baseline: Neither the Son of Heaven seated upon the throne nor the City Lord of Hubei Province would want people to learn that the mad divine spirit of Dongting Lake had killed thousands.
hunks.sol: Neither the Son of Heaven upon the throne nor the City Lord of Hubei Province would want the people to learn that the mad divine spirit of Dongting Lake had slaughtered thousands.

hunks.baseline: No, perhaps they would eliminate everyone involved in the matter immediately.
hunks.sol: Perhaps they would eliminate everyone involved immediately.

hunks.baseline: A martial artist from a prestigious sect might be another story, but an old boatman over seventy could be killed without anyone ever knowing.
hunks.sol: A martial artist from a prestigious sect might be another matter, but an old boatman past seventy could be disposed of without anyone ever knowing.

hunks.baseline: As the boatman exhaled as though his soul had left his body, a lifeline was extended to him.
hunks.sol: As the boatman exhaled like a man whose soul had left his body, a lifeline was extended to him.

hunks.baseline: “Erase everything from your memory. Sell your boat and spend the rest of your life in silence. If you do that, nothing will happen.”
hunks.sol: “Erase it all from your memory. Sell your boat, keep your mouth shut, and live out the rest of your days. Do that, and nothing will happen.”

hunks.baseline: The young medical apprentice finished speaking and rose from his seat. The boatman stared at his departing back with a dazed expression, then hurriedly called out.
hunks.sol: The young medical apprentice rose from his seat. The boatman stared dazedly at his departing back, then hurriedly called out.

hunks.baseline: Then he pointed to the brazier still burning in the corner of the room and the kettle slowly boiling atop it.
hunks.sol: Then he pointed to the brazier still burning in one corner of the room and the kettle simmering atop it.

hunks.baseline: “I boiled that decoction myself. Three times a day. After meals. Make sure you take it.”
hunks.sol: “I prepared that decoction myself. Take it three times a day, after meals. Without fail.”
